summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K announcing a transferable rights offering to raise equity capital. The company will distribute one right per share held as of June 4, 2026, allowing purchase of one share at $6.90 per right—a 3% discount to the 30-day VWAP. Up to 6,550,435 shares are offered. The subscription period runs June 5–23, 2026, tradable on NYSE American under the symbol "LGL RT". An oversubscription privilege is available for fully-exercising holders but not for secondary-market purchasers. This is a classic rights offering with transferable rights and oversubscription feature; watch subscription take-up and secondary market price to gauge dilution.
